fieldNotes.facility: 1203 Bilter Rd, Aurora, IL - Kraft Foods/Heinz cold-storage portion of the multi-tenant Aurora Distribution Center. Confirmed via web research (HSA Commercial, Manta, Yellow Pages) plus visual lock on industrial building at supplied coords.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Z21 satellite shows a small dark rectangular structure (guard-shack footprint) sitting in the middle of the truck entry apron at the SE corner where the drive opens onto Bilter Rd. Single controlled pinch-point for both inbound and outbound trucks.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Distinct ~3-4m booth-sized structure visible at z21 on the truck pad, separated from the main building - characteristic small staffed shack. Consistent with Jake's calibration baseline that pegs this site as the #1 Gate+GS archetype.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron between Bilter Rd setback and the gate booth - trucks can pull off the road and stage before checking in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved area immediately inside the gate before drop-yard rows / dock apron.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: From gate to dock face is ~150m of straight paved drive that can easily queue 5+ tractors.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted approximately 30 dock doors along the long south face of the building from z18/z19 imagery - mid-band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: South drop yard shows ~70+ visible parked trailers in dense rows; capacity ~90 stalls.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single SE-corner gate handles both directions.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Visible single inbound lane at the booth; counted from z21 satellite but lane striping faint.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single outbound lane assumed - symmetric to entry.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Gate apron is wide but already configured as a single-lane controlled pinch-point with the guard booth in the middle - retrofitting an express bypass would require relocating the booth.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Set inside the Aurora/Naperville metro fabric - dense suburban development on all sides (offices, parking, retail) along the I-88/Bilter corridor.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single south-facing dock cluster handles all truck traffic; no separate ship/rcv face.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: False for Kraft footprint specifically. The neighboring large building to the NW across the pond is a separate parcel/tenant in the same multi-tenant Aurora Distribution Center campus, not part of the Kraft yard.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in the gate path or drop-yard.
fieldNotes.rail: No rail spur enters the Kraft parcel. Rail line visible north of the campus but does not serve this building.
fieldNotes.streetView: Bilter Rd Street View from the public ROW shows a landscaped berm with trees screening the dock face; the on-site pano (2018) sits on the truck pad and confirms the entry point's geometry. Public-road view is consistent with a single set-back industrial driveway.
